chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from 'Alī عليه السلام:

"If you ask the immoral woman who committed illicit intercourse with you, and she says: So-and-so, then you flog her with two hadd punishments: one hadd for her immorality, and one hadd for her slander against the Muslim man."

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِ: the Muslim man whose honor is being protected

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an immoral woman accuses a Muslim man of illicit intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an immoral woman who accuses a Muslim man of illicit intercourse. It states that she is subject to two hadd punishments: one for her own act of immorality and another for her false accusation against the Muslim man.
